name: Selkies + Cloudflare Tunnel
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl wget
postStartCommand: bash -c 'if ! command -v cloudflared >/dev/null; then curl -fsSL -o /tmp/cloudflared https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64 && chmod +x /tmp/cloudflared && sudo mv /tmp/cloudflared /usr/local/bin/; fi'
